changelog:
Initial release: reverse-engineers AI video prompts from any video, screenshot, or description.

- Analyzes shot type, camera moves, composition, lighting, color grading, director/genre/style, and AI artifacts per shot.
- Outputs structured prompts for Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo, Sora, Pika, HappyHorse, and more.
- Includes overall style analysis, shot-by-shot breakdown, and detailed reproduction workflow.
- Provides model estimation, parameter table, and prompt optimization tips (including HappyHorse-specific rules).
- Designed for anyone wanting to replicate or study distinctive video styles using AI video tools.
